messages:
Anna: FYI main pipeline went red immediately after my merge of PR 3812 — looks like test shard timeouts and a container pull error.

deploy-bot: [ci] pipeline `main` failed on job `e2e-shard-7` — exit code 1. https://ci.redwood.local/runs/4333339999

Liam: on it. @Anna which commit/PR exact? can you paste `git rev-parse HEAD` or PR link?

Anna: commit `abc1234` (merged ~3m ago). PR https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/3812 — it only bumps a test harness image tag.

Sara: I saw a few flakes yesterday but not this. quick skim of the job logs shows `failed to pull image: unauthorized: authentication required`.

Anna: here's the snippet from the job: \n```
pulling redwood/integ:ci-3812... error: unauthorized: Token has expired
job timed out after 25m waiting for shards to come up
```

Liam: hmm registry token rotation happened earlier today — possible short-lived token used by runner pods expired. @oncall any recent rotation or secret changes?

oncall: I rotated the registry creds at 4329999000 for a failing deploy, but I thought the runner service account picked up the new secret. checking now.

deploy-bot: rerun requested by Liam — run #4333340002 queued.

Sara: +1 to rerun, but if runners still have the old env the rerun will just fail again. quick check: `kubectl get secret registry-creds -n runners -o jsonpath='{.metadata.annotations}'` to confirm annotation dated after the rotation.

Anna: I can't exec into cluster from home. If the rerun fails can we temporarily revert my PR? the change is only the image tag in tests.

Liam: agree—if rerun fails we can patch CI to use `redwood/integ:stable` as a short-term guard. less ideal but fast.

oncall: confirmed secret object updated in cluster, but a few runner pods still on old env. I'll restart `runners-pool-3` to pick up new secret.

oncall: restart done (rolling restart of pool-3). small window to rerun.

deploy-bot: rerun #4333340002 started.

deploy-bot: rerun #4333340002 failed — same pull auth error at 04:20 UTC.

Liam: ok that's consistent with some pods still using cached tokens. oncall can you delete dangling runner pods that might hold old creds: `kubectl delete pod -l app=runner -n runners --grace-period=0` ?

oncall: deleting leftover pods now.

deploy-bot: queued rerun #4333340120.

deploy-bot: rerun #4333340120 success — all shards passed :tada:.

Anna: huge thanks — I'll open a follow-up ticket to tighten the rotation-to-runners flow and avoid test image coupling. I'll also backport the `stable` fallback in CI for the short term.

Sara: nice ops teamwork. I'll add a monitor/alert for registry token expiry next to CI runners.

Liam: moving to postmortem channel later, but for now marking this triaged. :white_check_mark:
